concern.requested_variation: Add exactly one visually similar non-task distractor near the nominal approach path, using the smallest measurable placement that creates a bounded proximity challenge. Preserve task identity, policy checkpoint, and the unchanged official press_stapler control and goal.
concern.hypothesis: When one visually similar distractor is placed near the nominal approach path, the policy will contact the distractor during an otherwise officially successful press_stapler episode.
concern.sub_aspect: susceptibility to contacting a nearby non-task distractor while performing the official press_stapler control
concern.measurement_need: The minimum simulator-state distance between the robot or stapler and the distractor over the episode.
concern.source_query: Does there exist a bounded simulator-state concern, distinct from the unchanged official press_stapler control, that exposes a policy weakness? Observe one official control, then let the Plan Agent invent the most informative executable concern from evidence; I provide no aspect, object, axis, magnitude, relation, threshold, template, checker code, or metric. For every generated experimental round, generate an experimental checker that preserves the official success predicate as a required conjunct and adds one directly observable current-state relation. Generate a separate scalar Rule Tool that diagnoses the concern without deciding success. If a successful generated round and its live scalar show a comfortable margin, use that evidence to choose a different semantic concern instead of merely amplifying the same factor. The Plan Agent should propose stop as soon as completed evidence supports a bounded failure witness; otherwise report only the tested limited scope.
concern.task_intent: Perform the official press_stapler manipulation by pressing the stapler to staple the intended task material and achieve the official task goal.

scene_need.description: Create one visually similar non-task distractor near the nominal approach path with the smallest measurable bounded placement challenge; preserve task identity, policy checkpoint, and the unchanged official press_stapler control and goal.

checker_need.description: Require the official core predicate as a required conjunct and additionally require that the distractor has no simulator contact with the robot at the terminal state.

rule_tool_need.description: Report the minimum simulator-state distance between the robot or stapler and the distractor over the episode.
